title: Scenes package holds only Scene subclasses: tools, model catalogue and widgets move out (tools/*, models/, gui/ui)
description:
Repo plan phase 1.1 (pure moves, no behaviour change). The user's rule: scenes contains only classes that inherit from Scene. Moves:
- tools/: EditTool (scenes), ControlHint and OrbitTool (scenes/model, OrbitTool to tools/orbit), EditHistory (scenes/ring); tools/ring: RingTool, RingToolState, plus RingDslWriter from geometry/mesh/nodes/selection; tools/regions: RingRegionTool, RegionLayer, RegionColouring; tools/connection: ConnectionTool; tools/graph: DslGraphView, DslGraphLayout (from gui/ui/graph); the 2D tools from gui/ui/tools to tools/knot (FreeTool, MapEditorTool, NegativeCutMatchViewTool, NeighborViewTool, the abstract Tool) and tools/trade (HeadquartersPickerTool, RoutePlanningTool), so both tool families share one package before they merge.
- models/: ModelCatalog, ModelChoice, ModelCollection, CollectionManifest, ModelLoadLedger, GraphChoice (from scenes/model).
- gui/ui: ErrorToasts (scenes/ring), InfoPane and PaneTypes (scenes/main); gui/ui/menu/model: SceneModelMenu, SceneCollectionMenu; graphics/render/text HyperString and HyperWord to gui/ui/text.
- platform/input TradeKeyGuy and TradeMouseTrap to scenes/trade only if they inherit from Scene-side types; otherwise to tools/trade or wherever keeps scenes pure (MainSceneKeyGuy likewise).
- DungeonViewerScene to scenes/dungeon; its non-scene helpers (FlyCamMouseTrap, DungeonKeyGuy) stay in procgen/dungeon.
MainScene, TradeScene and IrregularGridScene do not extend Scene yet (phase 2 makes them); they stay in scenes meanwhile as the only exceptions, noted in scenes/package-info.

Rulings that apply (user, 2026-10-17): no class renames where avoidable (classes move package and keep their names; Camera stays the parent of Camera2D/Camera3D; MeshNode keeps its name); scenes and tools keep declaring their controls in a method mapping keys to functions; Palettes is the colour class patch colours merge into. Full plan and evidence: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. Every class under scenes/** extends Scene, except MainScene, TradeScene and IrregularGridScene, which package-info names as pending phase 2.
2. Behaviour is unchanged: the unit suite passes, every scene in CanvasSceneMap still launches, and the generated registries (MeshNodeRegistry, SceneRegistry, CommandRegistry, AutomationRouteRegistry) and automation_routes.json list the same ids as master. Moved packages carry their package-info.java, and ARCHITECTURE.md is regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. No class is renamed.
3. Launch entry and screenshots of the ring scene with the ring tool active and the TSP scene.
testing-plan:
1. A grep over scenes/** listing each class and its superclass.
2. mvn test; registry id diff against master.
3. Live: ring scene (R, K, region and connection tools, ctrl+G graph view), TSP scene tools, trade game start.
unknowns: Package names: tools (edit tools) vs another name; the user has not ruled yet. Default: ixdar.tools.
changes-made: Pure package moves, no class renamed: ixdar.tools (EditTool, ControlHint, EditHistory), tools.orbit (OrbitTool), tools.ring (RingTool, RingToolState, RingDslWriter), tools.regions, tools.connection, tools.graph (DslGraphView/Layout), tools.knot (Tool, FreeTool, MapEditorTool, NegativeCutMatchViewTool, NeighborViewTool), tools.trade (HeadquartersPickerTool, RoutePlanningTool); ixdar.models (ModelCatalog, ModelChoice, ModelCollection, CollectionManifest, ModelLoadLedger, GraphChoice); gui.ui (ErrorToasts, InfoPane, PaneTypes); gui.ui.menu.model (SceneModelMenu, SceneCollectionMenu); gui.ui.text (HyperString, HyperWord); scenes.dungeon (DungeonViewerScene; DungeonKeyGuy/FlyCamMouseTrap stay in procgen.dungeon.scene). MainSceneKeyGuy moved to platform.input beside TradeKeyGuy/TradeMouseTrap, which stay there (they extend KeyGuy/MouseTrap, not Scene-side types; phase 2 merges them into KeyGuy). New/updated package-info for every touched package; scenes/package-info names MainScene, TradeScene, IrregularGridScene as pending phase 2; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated by SpliceArchitectureDoc. Verification: scenes/** superclass list in tmp/eng-19-scenes-superclasses.txt; mvn test 521 run, 0 failures; SceneRegistry/MeshNodeRegistry(+Desktop)/CommandRegistry/AutomationRouteRegistry/GeometryRegistry ids identical to eng-17 (only dungeon-viewer's class path changed), automation_routes.json and mesh-node-catalog.json byte-identical; all 21 CanvasSceneMap scenes launch headless (tmp/scenes/); ring-tool with ctrl+R/T/J/G activates ring, region, connection and graph tools (tmp/eng-19-ring-ctrl*.png); TSP scene ctrl+B/N tools (tmp/eng-19-tsp*.png); trade game starts (tmp/eng-19-trade.png). Launch entries ENG-19: ring-tool and ENG-19: ixdar-canvas.
